result.topic_en: Notes on the transformation of quadratic differential forms: two second-degree forms with coefficients a and b, their determinants A, B and adjoint forms, the relation between determinants under a change of variables, and the reduction of the transformation of equation (I) to the transformation of the expression sum alpha dx dx, ending with the cylindrical line element.
